adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces pagination computations in `admin-group.js.es6`/controller: `totalPages` is `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` when `user_count > 0`. This is off-by-one for exact multiples (e.g., `user_count=50`, `limit=50` yields `2` pages instead of `1`). Combined with `next` setting `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, the UI can navigate to `offset==user_count` (an empty page) and display `currentPage=2/totalPages=2`. The finding’s test-missing observation is consistent with the diff (no JS tests added), but the core issue is a real, verifiable correctness bug introduced by the new pagination math.
